coaching_notes: You always need to enter the market in early stages of its trend otherwise you'll end up losing your trade
You can't trade in a non trending market
if you'll follow each step carefully then the chances of loss are minimal
There is a good risk to reward ratio in this method

element_inventory: PRECONDITION: identify trend direction using the 4-hour timeframe and a trend line before trading
PRECONDITION: only place buy trades when the market is in an uptrend; only place sell trades when in a downtrend
PRECONDITION: only trade in a trending market (do not trade a non-trending market)
PRECONDITION: enter in the early stages of the trend
APPLICABILITY: usable on every currency pair
ENTRY (buy): draw Fibonacci retracement from swing low to recent swing high; enter when price touches the 50% or 61.8% line, anywhere between those two levels
ENTRY (sell): draw Fibonacci retracement from swing high to recent swing low; enter when price touches the 50% or 61.8% line, anywhere between those two levels
TAKE PROFIT (buy): above the previous swing high
STOP LOSS (buy): below the swing low
TAKE PROFIT (sell): below the previous swing low
STOP LOSS (sell): above the swing high
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the established trend. In an uptrend, draw a Fibonacci retracement from swing low to the recent swing high and enter a buy when price touches (anywhere between) the 50% and 61.8% levels. In a downtrend, draw Fibonacci from swing high to recent swing low and enter a sell when price touches the 50% or 61.8% level. Executed on the 1-hour timeframe with trend direction pre-identified on the 4-hour timeframe using a trend line.
strategies.exit_summary: For buys: take profit above the previous swing high; stop loss below the swing low. For sells: take profit below the previous swing low; stop loss above the swing high.
